prices.name: Standard listing
prices.what: Your job in the main feed for 30 days, then in the archive.

prices.name: Featured job
prices.what: Highlighted row and a place above regular listings in its category for 14 days.

prices.name: Pinned job
prices.what: Top of the home page and of its category for 7 days.

prices.name: 5-job pack
prices.what: Five featured jobs to use within 3 months.

prices.name: Company spotlight
prices.what: Your company in “Featured employers” on the home page and at the top of the companies list, plus a badge on your company page.

prices.name: Category or skill sponsor
prices.what: Your company named at the top of one category or skill page, for example “Engineering jobs · supported by you”.

prices.name: Branded listing
prices.what: A featured job with a cover image and a longer description written by you.
